name: @ppe/scan-kit
description: Reading things with a phone's camera or from photos, in the browser: the camera and its guide frame, two-frame steadiness, canvas helpers, a barcode reader and a text reader each in a worker, the readers' own files (a Vite plugin), the screen's pictures and their thumbnails, and a page's perspective (./perspective: its 4 corners found and flattened, in a worker). Shared by Scan SIMs (@ppe/sim-scan) and docs-import (docs/apps/docs-import-plan.md, section 6).
